$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md) by CI after every deploy. actorId pins the Actor that the first CI push created on 2026-11-10 (build 1.0.1), so a rename in actor.json updates the same Actor. isPublic stays false until the owner says go. The prices below are placeholders until they are measured on Apify: pricing apply is false, so CI sends none.
seoTitle: Wellfound Jobs Scraper - Startup Salary & Equity
seoDescription: Scrape Wellfound (AngelList) startup jobs by role, city and remote, newest first: salary, equity, startup stage, size and funding. No login or API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 512 MB, measured on Apify 2026-11-10: the empty form (578 search pages, Apify's daily test) took 60 s at 512 MB against 55 s at 1 GB and 51 s at 2 GB, for 54% of 1 GB's compute; peaks 196 to 282 MB on all 15 runs, a 4,060-row run 238 MB. The example input takes 9.5 to 11.5 s at any size.

pricing.$comment: Cost plus the owner's markup ladder for jobs batch 3 (FREE 100%, BRONZE 95%, SILVER 90%, GOLD 85%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 80%), from 15 Apify runs of 2026-11-10 at the unit prices of docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md: a job row costs a dataset write plus 4.0e-7 CU, a detailed row 3.7e-4 CU more (one job page each, measured where Wellfound slowed the address down). PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's price, as Apify stores them. The start covers a run's fixed cost and is raised until every measured run clears 80% at every tier: the lowest, a 1 GB read of every page that saved no job, is 82%. The house rule (5-15% under blackfalcondata/wellfound-scraper, $0.003 a job and $0.005 a run) would be about $0.0027 a job and $0.0045 a run.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: First pricing: measured cost plus a markup by tier

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, startup, places, remote, hybrid or onsite, pay and equity, years of experience, startup size, stage and badges, posting date and job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description, visa sponsorship, relocation, preferred time zones, skills, the startup's website, markets and funding, and the city, region and country.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
